summary: This tutorial introduces LibreOffice Impress, a free and open-source presentation software. It covers installation on GNU/Linux systems using the Synaptic Package Manager or downloading from official websites. Key features include various toolbars such as Title Bars, Menu Bars, Standard Bars, Formatting Bars, and Status Bars. The tutorial guides users through creating a new presentation by selecting templates, customizing slide designs, and adding text. Users learn to save presentations in the ODP format and how to export them as PDFs using Impress. Additionally, it explains how to open and save LibreOffice Impress presentations as Microsoft PowerPoint files for compatibility with other software. The tutorial also highlights the use of LibreOffice Manager within the LibreOffice suite for managing presentations.
